issues: needs rebase onto master; ModifyGameTextType conflict

cards.title: Squabbling Delegates
issues: change comes from base PR520, already on master identically; drops out after rebase

review.shared_changes: New ModifyGameTextType.OCCUPY_IN_GAME_TEXT_IS_CONTROL; new filters/GameTextOccupationFilters.occupies/occupiesWith(player, textSource[, cards]) (control instead of occupy when the text source carries that modification) and cards/conditions/GameTextOccupiesCondition. Tarfful switches from the global TreatsOccupyAsControlModifier (which made contested Forest Depths count as controlled for everything) to a ModifyGameTextModifier on Forest Depths. LocationControl/global control rules untouched; TreatsOccupyAsControlModifier left in place but now unused.
review.fix_instructions: Rebase legacy/integration-occupation onto current master (PR520 is already merged as 726bed869, identical content for Card12_159 and its tests) and retarget the PR base to master. Resolve ModifyGameTextType.java by keeping master's LEGACY__INTERRUPTS__VADER_MAY_BE_MAUL_OR_MARA_JADE and appending OCCUPY_IN_GAME_TEXT_IS_CONTROL after it (append-only, keep ordinals). After the rebase the PR should touch only GameTextOccupiesCondition, GameTextOccupationFilters, ModifyGameTextType, Card1272_018 and the two test files. No logic change needed.
review.notes: Interpretation is correct: 'Occupy on Forest Depths is treated as control' is a text replacement on the card Forest Depths (same pattern as other 'X treated as Y' Legacy text mods). The only Forest Depths with 'occupy' in its text is Legacy 1261_113 (LS attrition 'locations you occupy with a Wookiee'; DS 'Unless you occupy, your Force generation here is canceled'), so the master implementation (granting control of contested sites, enabling LS drains there) was wrong. Tests: 2 filter unit tests (source scope, player scope) and updated Tarfful VTS (contested = no drain/no destiny bonus, works while Tarfful elsewhere, unchanged without Tarfful, genuine control still works). Dependents: PR 526 Forest Depths (1261_113) currently uses Filters.occupiesWith / OccupiesCondition and must switch to GameTextOccupationFilters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.Wookiee) and GameTextOccupiesCondition(playerId, self, self) after this lands, with a Tarfful interaction test.
